title: Local recovery of Zariski finiteness on an etale cover
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $c$ a proof-only canonical comparison context [lem-trf-scheme-zariski-etale-quasi-coherent-equivalence], and $F$ a quasi-coherent Zariski module [pqf-def-coherent]. If $c.\mathrm{extension}(F)$ has finite type on the small etale site, there exists a family $(f_i:Y_i\to T)_{i\in I}$ of etale maps [def-weil-etale-morphism], with $I$ in the object universe of the small etale site, which is an fpqc covering [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering], and every tensor pullback $f_i^*F$ [def-pc-module-pullback] has finite type on $Y_i$. If the extension of $F$ is of finite presentation, there is such a family with every ordinary scheme-module pullback $f_i^*F$ of finite presentation. Tensor and ordinary pullbacks are the canonically isomorphic left adjoints to pushforward. This asserts finiteness only on the covering members, not descent to $T$. Empty schemes, empty covering families and zero modules are included.

proof.text: Apply the site-local finite-type or finite-presentation condition at the final etale object to choose a covering with finite generators or finite free presentations. The index is in the object universe since the site objects and arrows are in that universe. The slice over each covering member U is U_et. Tensor-pullback composition identifies the restricted extension with the extension of u^*F, and the pullback is quasi-coherent.

Identify the finite free terms with extensions of Zariski finite free modules. Full faithfulness lifts the finite generating maps or the presentation matrices. For finite generation the lifted map has a quasi-coherent cokernel whose extension is zero; faithfulness forces its identity to be zero, so the map is epi. For finite presentation the Zariski cokernel extends to the required etale module; full faithfulness lifts the comparison isomorphism and its inverse identities, giving a finite presentation of u^*F.

Etale covering families are fpqc. This supplies the displayed precoverage membership without descending finiteness to T. Uniqueness of left adjoints to module pushforward gives the canonical isomorphism between tensor and ordinary pullbacks, so either presentation can be used. The empty cover and rank-zero presentations satisfy the same construction.

lean.statement:
theorem zariskiEtale_finiteness_local_recovery (T : Scheme.{u})
    (c : ZariskiEtaleModuleContext T) (F : T.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] :
    ((c.extension.obj F).IsFiniteType →
      ∃ (I : Type (u + 1)) (Y : I → Scheme.{u}) (f : ∀ i, Y i ⟶ T),
        (∀ i, Etale (f i)) ∧
          Presieve.ofArrows Y f ∈ Scheme.fpqcPrecoverage T ∧
          ∀ i, ((tensorPullback (f i)).obj F).IsFiniteType) ∧
    ((c.extension.obj F).IsFinitePresentation →
      ∃ (I : Type (u + 1)) (Y : I → Scheme.{u}) (f : ∀ i, Y i ⟶ T),
        (∀ i, Etale (f i)) ∧
          Presieve.ofArrows Y f ∈ Scheme.fpqcPrecoverage T ∧
          ∀ i, ((pullback (f i)).obj F).IsFinitePresentation)
